check_box.label: Hide avatars high above me on the mini-map
check_box.name: hide_above
check_box.tool_tip: Avatars more than this height above you get no dot, no hover info and no right-click, e.g. people sitting on build platforms during combat.

slider.label: Higher than (m)
slider.name: hide_above_meters
slider.tool_tip: How many metres above your own height an avatar must be to be hidden.
